name: Trampoline park and indoor playground

pf.license.need: if: where the state's amusement-ride or trampoline court rules apply, the park holds the state's permit or registration and passes its inspections; elsewhere the business registration only; a mobile inflatable party follows the same state rules where they cover inflatables
pf.license.ask: the business registration; any state amusement or trampoline permit, with its last inspection date; the liability insurance certificate
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.blocks: goes live on identity and the registration; where the state requires a permit, only once it's on file
pf.license.renewals: permits, inspections and insurance reminded 30 and 7 days before; a lapse pauses new bookings
pf.license.insurance: liability insurance, as the state or the landlord asks
pf.license.staff: court monitors trained by the park, with first aid and CPR cards (certificates, not state licenses)
pf.license.background: background checks for party hosts and staff who work with children, where the park or the rules require them

pf.services.shape: table: timed jump sessions with a set number of jumpers per start time (a seat in a session), and party rooms booked for a set time (a space)
pf.services.examples: the example park's own prices (Lee Jump Park), not a standard

list.name: Open jump, 60 minutes
list.capacity: 120 jumpers per start time, every 30 minutes

list.name: Toddler time (12 and under, with a parent)
list.price: $25 a child; the parent jumps free

list.name: Birthday party package
list.price: $140 for 10 jumpers, $10 each extra, up to 30
list.kind: one price per party, with a minimum
list.length: 2 hours: 90 minutes of jump time, then 30 minutes in a party room
list.after: the $100 rest paid at the front desk on the day, for the final count

list.name: Field trip (school or camp group)
list.after: one bill to the school or camp after

list.name: Party for 30 or more, quoted from the number of guests
list.price: $600 quoted; over $500, so Sam OKs it first
list.before: a $120 deposit once the written estimate is signed
list.after: the $480 rest charged to the saved card when the team texts DONE

list.name: Mobile play party
list.after: the $110 rest charged to the saved card when the team texts DONE

pf.services.capacity: jumpers per start time, set by the court count and the park's safety limit; party rooms are spaces, one party at a time
pf.services.zones: a toddler area for 5 and under; the main courts for 6 and up; dodgeball and the foam pit by age and height
pf.services.skills: court monitor, party host, mobile party attendant (setup, anchoring, wind checks)
pf.services.notBookings: grip socks, the snack bar, arcade cards and food bought at the desk stay outside Rosie

beforeTimes: which session or party, and the date and time
how many jumpers, and each one's age group (toddler, 6 to 12, teen, adult)
for a party: the expected number of jumpers
for a mobile party: the kind of place (a yard, a school, a park) and the town
afterTime: the birthday child's first name for the party host, if the parent wants it used
anything staff should know to help, like a child who needs extra help or a hearing need
securePage: a waiver for every jumper: an adult signs their own; a parent or legal guardian signs for each child
the waiver's health check: people who are pregnant, or have heart, back, neck or bone problems, or a recent surgery or injury, shouldn't jump
the parent's OK for a 13 to 17 year old to come and leave on their own
the party's guest list (first names only), and an emergency contact
for a mobile party: the street address and where the power outlet is
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult; a parent or guardian books for children; only a child's own parent or legal guardian signs that child's waiver
pf.questions.told: everyone on the courts wears the park's grip socks (bought at the desk if they have none); children 12 and under need a parent or an adult 18+ in the park; arrive 15 minutes early to check in

stop.words: someone hurt or unwell right now: a head or neck injury, a broken bone, trouble breathing, not waking up
stop.say: Call 911 now. Don't move someone with a head, neck or back injury.

goOn.words: pregnant, a heart condition, a back or neck problem, a recent surgery or injury
goOn.what: the booking can go on for the others; the waiver says who shouldn't jump; the person decides, and Rosie gives no health advice

pf.safety.atThePark: a jumper hurt on the courts: the monitor stops that court, gives first aid, calls 911 when needed, and calls the parent at once if the parent isn't with them; an incident report goes on the secure page the same day; Sam is told
pf.safety.turnAway: anyone who seems drunk or high doesn't jump; a jumper who keeps breaking the court rules after a warning leaves the courts
pf.safety.weather: indoors: no weather limit; a mobile party outdoors stops the inflatable in winds over 20 mph, in lightning, or in rain

steps: a waiver for every jumper, signed on the secure page before the visit, good for 12 months; a party's guests' parents sign on a link the host forwards
the party's final headcount by 3 days before (it sets the food and the rest due)
a field trip: the chaperone list and each child's waiver the day before
a mobile party: the customer confirms the flat area, the power outlet and any permission the place needs (a school's or a park's) 3 days before, and marks sprinkler and underground lines before setup
pf.first_steps.prep: grip socks (from an earlier visit, or bought at the desk); comfortable clothes; empty pockets; arrive 15 minutes early

pf.visit.checkIn: at the front desk: the booker's code for the group; the desk sees which jumpers have a waiver on file, and each gets a wristband; the party host checks the party in
pf.visit.lateEntry: jump time ends at the session's set end; a late jumper gets the time left
pf.visit.missing: a jumper without a waiver signs on the desk tablet (a parent for a child) before jumping; a jumper without grip socks buys them at the desk; only that jumper waits
pf.visit.changes: extra party jumpers on the day are added at the per-jumper price if the room fits; the parent says yes first
pf.visit.children: children 12 and under need a parent or an adult 18+ in the park; 13 to 17 may come and leave on their own with the parent's OK on the waiver
pf.visit.done: the desk's check-in confirms the visit; the party host texts DONE at the party's end; the mobile team texts DONE after takedown

pf.money.before: jump passes paid in full when booking; a party's $40 deposit; field trips nothing before; a mobile party's $40 deposit
pf.money.after: a party's $100 rest at the front desk for the final count; a field trip's one bill after; a mobile party's $110 rest charged to the saved card at DONE
pf.money.cancel: jump passes: a full refund if moved or cancelled 2 hours or more before; a late cancel or no-show keeps $20. A party: free to cancel up to 7 days before; later the $40 deposit may be kept, only with Sam's yes. A mobile party keeps its $40 deposit on a late cancel, with Sam's yes.
pf.money.membership: none: no monthly membership is sold through Rosie
pf.money.tips: a tip for the party host on the desk's own reader, the business's own way; Rosie never asks
pf.money.fee2: Rosfield's $2 per confirmed booking applies: one $2 per booking, however many jumpers
pf.money.noSale: socks, food and arcade sales are outside Rosie

pf.messages.never: children's names, ages and health answers, and injury details: only on the secure page
pf.messages.staffTexts: the party host's day list shows the booker's name and the number of jumpers; the guest list opens on the secure page
pf.messages.minors: texts go to the parent who booked, never to a child

pf.staff.licenses: none from the state; first aid and CPR cards for court monitors, tracked by the park
pf.staff.skills: court monitor, party host, mobile party attendant
pf.staff.ratio: monitors per court as the park's safety plan sets; a mobile party always has 2 attendants
pf.staff.standIn: any trained host or monitor; nobody is booked by name
pf.staff.oks: Sam OKs refunds, party changes and field trips

pf.rules.waiver: no jumper on the courts without a signed waiver; a child's waiver signed only by their parent or legal guardian
pf.rules.courts: one jumper per trampoline square; similar-size jumpers together on the dodgeball court; each court's weight limit as its maker sets
pf.rules.kids: 12 and under with a parent or an adult 18+ in the park; toddler time for 5 and under with a parent
pf.rules.inspections: the park's daily court checks; the state's inspections where its rules require them
pf.rules.inflatables: outdoor inflatables anchored as the maker says and stopped in winds over 20 mph, lightning or rain, with an attendant always there
pf.rules.records: waivers kept as long as the park's insurer requires, and with the booking for 7 years; incident reports kept with the booking
pf.rules.cancelRight: no cancel period for jump or party time already given
pf.rules.reviews: a rating once after the visit, never after an injury

pf.edges.headcount: the party's final headcount 3 days before sets the food and the rest; more on the day are added if the room fits; fewer than 10 still pay for 10
pf.edges.injury: a jumper hurt: first aid, 911 if needed, the parent called at once, an incident report the same day; no rating asked after it
pf.edges.noWaiver: a jumper without a waiver signs at the desk before jumping; only that jumper waits
pf.edges.impaired: a jumper who seems drunk or high doesn't jump; the rest of the group jumps; no refund for that person
pf.edges.teenAlone: 13 to 17 may come and leave on their own with the parent's OK on the waiver
pf.edges.closed: a power cut or a court problem closes the park: new times or a full refund
pf.edges.wind: a mobile party: the attendants stop the inflatable in winds over 20 mph, lightning or rain; time lost to weather comes back as a partial refund or a new date
pf.edges.membership: a membership renews each month on its date; a declined charge gets one pay link; frozen or ended with 30 days' notice
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way

notes: Trampoline park: a table-style place to book (jump passes, a party room, a school trip, a mobile play party), from the restaurant pilot, with the verified sample plug-in as the base (work/testdrive/trampoline-park.md). Refit to the rebuilt master (N4, Oct 27): the sample's own money words are gone; money is the amounts rows. Flow A (the family comes to Lee Jump Park): open jump, 60 minutes, 4 jumpers, $140 paid in full, a $20 fee on a late cancel or no-show; a birthday party package for 10, $140: $40 deposit when booking, $100 rest at the front desk, $40 kept on a late cancel; a school field trip, $14 a jumper ($280), nothing taken, one bill to the school after. Flow B (Lee Mobile Play comes to the customer): a mobile play party, 2 hours, $150: $40 deposit, the $110 rest on the saved card at DONE, $40 fee; a toddler party at home, $179, a card saved for the $89 fee, the bill texted after; a 1-hour toddler play at home, $75, paid in full. Services with no row of their own are left out. The master's example prices are used only where they are this work's price for the same role (for example $140 with a $40 deposit and a $100 rest); each shown amount is one of the amounts rows, and the master's price-change, plan and bank-transfer examples are reworded or turned off. Names: Lee Jump Park (300 Cedar Ave), Lee Mobile Play (310 Harbor Rd), front desk Bea and Theo, hosts Pim and Joss; Alex M. is the customer. Facts: groups, children, forms (waivers), spaces (party rooms), capacitycheck (jumpers per start time), extrawork (extra time). No plans, packs, memberships, stages or bank transfer (the membership service is removed). Waivers stay on: a parent signs for each child on the secure page (A4-43, A8-02 kept). Licenses: the owner's own papers, shown as given, never checked (D96): the license lookups are off (S1-60 '1 A license', S2-28 '1 Yes, each one'). $2 applies to every booking (D97). Sensitive is off: children's details are covered by the children fact and stay on the secure page. Settings: set start times in both flows; cutoff 24 hours before (A), 2 days before (B). The verified gaps (work/gaps/trampoline-park.json) stand; the membership gap no longer applies to this work.
